name: Yi Xiazhiling
source:
A teenager trapped in the memories of past meets a disoriented girl who has lost her memories. What could they change, and what could they save? Where would the fate lead them? Their story starts from here.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/871570/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个被困在过去记忆中的少年遇到了一个失去记忆的迷失方向的女孩。他们可以改变什么，可以拯救什么？命运会将他们引向何方？他们的故事就从这里开始。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/871570/]Steam[/url]]
